limits: The queue was supplied by an earlier cohort check. This task verifies its exact 47 public source occurrences and original issuer documents; it does not reread vendor rows or independently recreate the cohort eligibility/uniqueness selection.
An original issuer CIK/name/symbol observation is not a CUSIP, share-class or vendor security link. No source supplies a complete effective interval, and repeated appearances do not imply continuity.

All validated acceptance clocks precede January 1, 2020. Acceptance, report, filing and change dates remain separate; none proves first public website availability, source known-at, or the applicability of today's preserved bytes at a historical cutoff.

Any original metadata differences, unsupported structures and retrieval failures remain explicit. No queue record is omitted, no amendment is removed, and no reporting owner is substituted for the issuer.
HTTP Last-Modified/Date and collection clocks describe the retrieved copies only. Complete submission preservation does not mean the transaction or ownership content was analyzed.

parsing_scope.cik_comparison: Preserve raw fields, strip surrounding whitespace only for numeric comparison, require 1–10 positive ASCII digits, and zero-pad that comparison key to ten digits
parsing_scope.name_and_symbol_comparison: Exact parsed XML text and exact header name versus queued public strings; no spelling, case, whitespace or ticker repair
parsing_scope.original_header: Accession, form, acceptance, filing/change dates, issuer CIK/name, and all reporting-owner CIK roles; addresses and reporting-owner names not exported
parsing_scope.original_submission_bytes: Complete original SEC text preserved, including uninterpreted remaining filing content
parsing_scope.ownership_xml: XML pull parser receives only the original prefix ending at the single direct issuer element; documentType, periodOfReport, dateOfOriginalSubmission and issuer CIK/name/symbol are retained. No parser input includes reportingOwner, transaction, holdings, footnotes, remarks or signature sections
parsing_scope.raw_byte_offsets: Zero-based offsets into the complete original submission; end exclusive. raw_value/raw_xml_text slices preserve bytes decoded as UTF-8; parsed_text additionally applies XML entity decoding

selection_policy_from_supplied_queue: All 47 cohort securities with missing/unsupported current-header CIK and exactly one unique earlier issuer observation; select earliest globally unique earlier filing per security with deterministic accession/source-ordinal tie break. Public source columns only.
